notMedical: This is not a medical assessment.

templates.trendStable: {name}'s speech has stayed close to their usual pattern over the last {weeks} weeks. {notMedical}
templates.trendChange: Since {since}, {name} {changes}. Worth mentioning at the next check-up. {notMedical}
templates.trendNotReady: There isn't a trend for {name} yet. Recollect needs a few weeks of conversations first. {notMedical}
templates.storyPromptFor: You mentioned {entity}. Would you like to tell me more?

mean_pause_s.label: Mean pause length (seconds)
mean_pause_s.question: Her pauses in conversation have grown longer over several weeks. Is that worth looking into?

pause_rate.label: Pauses per minute of speech
pause_rate.question: She pauses more often mid-sentence than she used to. Could anything be contributing to that?

long_pause_rate.label: Pauses of 2 seconds or more per minute
long_pause_rate.question: She has more long pauses when she talks. Is that worth looking into?

phonation_ratio.phrase: spends less of the time speaking
phonation_ratio.label: Share of the time spent speaking
phonation_ratio.question: She spends less of the time speaking during a conversation. Could tiredness or hearing play a part?

speech_rate_wpm.label: Speech rate (words per minute)
speech_rate_wpm.question: She speaks more slowly than she used to. Could any of her medicines or her sleep affect this?

mattr.label: Vocabulary variety (moving type-token ratio)
mattr.question: She uses a narrower range of words than a few months ago. Is that worth looking into?

vague_rate.label: Vague words per 100 words
vague_rate.question: She uses words like 'thing' and 'stuff' more often. Is that worth looking into?

pronoun_noun_ratio.phrase: uses more pronouns in place of names
pronoun_noun_ratio.label: Pronouns per noun
pronoun_noun_ratio.question: She says 'he' or 'she' more often where she used to say a name. Is that worth looking into?

mean_utt_len.label: Words per sentence
mean_utt_len.question: Her sentences have become shorter. Could anything be contributing to that?

idea_density.phrase: packs less detail into each sentence
idea_density.label: Idea density (per 10 words)
idea_density.question: Her sentences carry less detail than before. Is that worth looking into?

self_corrections.label: Self-corrections per 100 words
self_corrections.question: She corrects herself more often while talking. Is that worth looking into?

named_recall.label: Familiar people and places referred to by name (share)
named_recall.question: She names familiar people and places less often. Is that worth looking into?

retell_rate.phrase: retells the same stories more often
retell_rate.label: Stories that repeat an earlier one (share per week)
retell_rate.question: She retells the same stories more often. Is that worth looking into?

new_entity_rate.phrase: brings up fewer new people and places
new_entity_rate.label: New people, places and events per story
new_entity_rate.question: Her stories bring up fewer new people and places. Is that worth looking into?

orientation_asks.phrase: asks about the day, people and tablets more often
orientation_asks.label: Orientation questions per day
orientation_asks.question: She asks about the day, people and her tablets more often. What would help her day feel more settled?

evening_orientation_share.phrase: asks more of those questions in the evening
evening_orientation_share.label: Share of orientation questions asked 16:00–22:00
evening_orientation_share.question: More of her questions come in the evening. What could help in the late afternoon?

doctorQuestionsIntro: Questions you might ask. They come from the changes Recollect noticed in her everyday speech; only her doctor can say what they mean.
